description: a lean young man master archer with black hair tied back and a silver diadem with a green gem, elegant black leather armour with silver plates and silver filigree, a silver pauldron shaped like a hawk's wing, a long dark green cloak hanging behind, black trousers and tall black boots, one long black recurve bow with silver tips strapped upright on the back behind the shoulder, the whole bow above the waist and behind the body, never in front of the legs, nothing in the hands but the reins, sitting upright and relaxed in the middle of the saddle exactly like the rider of the reference, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the face, chest and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near leg showing and the far leg hidden behind the horse, the near thigh lying forward along the saddle and the lower leg hanging straight down from the knee to the foot, one normal slim leg, never two legs, the far leg completely hidden behind the horse, not squatting, not crouching, the knees never apart, not tucked up, not slanting, both upper arms down along the body and both forearms reaching forward, the two hands close together in front of the body above the horse's neck holding the reins, the same size and place as the reference rider, the whole figure from the top of the head to the foot inside the image, nothing under the rider, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look only: the face, hair, headwear, clothes and colours; not the pose and not the bow in the hand

a finished rider of the game which the author accepted: copy exactly how it sits in the middle of the saddle, seen exactly from the side in profile, only the near leg showing, the near thigh forward along the saddle and the lower leg hanging straight down, and how both hands reach forward together to the reins; not its face, clothes or colours
the pose of the figure: sitting sideways, the near thigh forward and the lower leg hanging straight down, only the near leg; not its hood or cloak
